execution: Actual corb run; denial produced in its attached uid-1000 guest shell while Pi was idle. No model prompt, credentials, model response, or user project.
host: Linux; QEMU emulator version 11.1.1 (openSUSE Tumbleweed). The default sandbox could not create the VM Unix socket, so the same isolated run was executed outside it. Acceleration was selected automatically and was not recorded.
